sources.title: nijatzeynalov/gpt2-azerbaijani-small · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: gpt2-azerbaijani-smallv0 is a state-of-the-art language model for Azerbaijani based on the GPT-2 small model. It was trained on Azerbaijani Wikipedia using Transfer Learning and Fine-tuning techniques in ~ 29 hours, on one GPU - 1 x NVIDIA Tesla K80.

sources.title: README.md · allmalab/gpt2-aze at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model is based on the GPT-2 architecture, specifically trained on Azerbaijani text. It serves as one of the first foundational models designed to generate and understand Azerbaijani language content.

sources.title: GitHub - MahammadNuriyev62/azgpt: First open-source continually ...
sources.snippet: Project Goal AzGPT aims to adapt a strong open-source base language model (such as Qwen 3.5, Gemma 3, or Llama) for Azerbaijani through continual pretraining. The objective is to produce a model that understands and generates fluent Azerbaijani text while retaining the general capabilities of the base model.

sources.snippet: Yet another challenge is the small size of the community that's devoted to the development of open-source language models for Azerbaijani. The challenges regarding digitalization and script differences are further discussed in the third section.
